item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
The first two sentences of the note make 813's intentions clear, the only reason it has to hijack eyeballs is self-inspection. "That which was paired and now separated" could be a reference to the way the shards separate from the main mass. So, an individual shard's mission would be complete if an afflicted were to look at 813; and then it would be time for "must be made whole again". What's worse than glass shooting into your eye? Glass shooting out of your eye! If it didn't take the time to retract the microfilaments, the results could be quite splashy and/or dangly.

I keep circling around some insight/pun/connection with the bible verse about motes and beams in one's own and one's neighbor's eyes respectively. Possibly also that one Niven/Pournelle novel. But nothing is gelling.

+1 for slinging all the squick I can take using minimum gore.

item.content:encoded:
Neutral for now.

Sounds like the convey was

+ spoiler
- hide

a trap meant to get this thing into Foundation hands eyes. My problem with this is that while the initial idea is great (shards in your eye) the effect is a little bland. They're sitting motionless and staring for a while, sure, meditating/being controlled/being probed by TBG, and it eventually consumes them, but that's not that too creative or interesting. This might be helped (without changing much) by giving us a glimpse of what they're seeing/doing while in the trans. Perhaps you can tell this with a truth-serum induced interview log? Or perhaps they learn new abilities or arcane knowledge without realizing it? I dunno, but I think it needs a little more.
